title: Oirat Mongols capture the Ming emperor at Tumu
summary: Oirat Mongol forces under Esen Taishi destroyed a large Ming army at the Tumu fortress and captured the Zhengtong Emperor.
reason: Trade disputes on the northern frontier led Esen to raid China, and the young emperor marched out on a poorly planned campaign urged by the eunuch Wang Zhen.
significance: The disaster turned Ming China toward a defensive frontier policy that led to the rebuilding of the Great Wall.
